static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.hypothesis: Changing feature_context.features, supplied_features, BodyStarted resources and RequestRecorded resources together may preserve all internal equalities without an external actual-argument anchor.
static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.required_r6b_attack: coordinated substitution of actual features and origin, not only mutation of one projection

static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.target: callback omitted/extra and complete dispatch ledger
static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.hypothesis: dispatch_coverage is compared to function_dispatches itself; coordinated omission or insertion of a dispatch and matching FunctionInvoked projection may evade a self-referential completeness check.
static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.required_r6b_attack: joint callback omission, joint callback insertion and callback-to-ordinary reclassification

static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.target: Func alias, With target, origin and phase
static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.hypothesis: A coordinated change to dispatch func_id and FunctionInvoked func_id, or to callsite witness and phase on both projections, may remain internally consistent without proving the real carrier/producer/callsite.
static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.required_r6b_attack: joint identity substitution, carrier alias collapse, With callsite substitution and phase substitution

static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.hypothesis: BodyStarted checks the dispatch kind and execution_id but may not bind its entry dispatch Func identity to the actual ContextBlock carrier, allowing a callback Func identity under a context_body_entry label.
static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.required_r6b_attack: replace the body-entry func_id with a callback func_id while retaining the declared dispatch kind

static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.hypothesis: The focal checker compares occurrence coordinate, location, producer and content but does not compare key/action; coordinated replacement of event and occurrence location or of both event/origin Span may hide a wrong join or a read/root Span.
static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.required_r6b_attack: wrong key, wrong action, coordinated wrong location, coordinated read Span and coordinated root Span

static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.hypothesis: The checker rejects repeated lineage_id but may accept distinct edges whose content-id path returns to an earlier content id before reaching the walked content.
static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.required_r6b_attack: multi-edge source->mid->source->walked cycle plus dangling/unreferenced lineage

static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.target: Dict collision, nesting, order and coverage
static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.hypothesis: dict_coverage is compared to typed_dict_values itself; coordinated removal/addition can be self-consistent, while nested payload type/order can change without an independent carrier anchor.
static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.required_r6b_attack: joint coverage omission/insertion, nested Dict-to-Func substitution and coordinated nested/top-level reordering

static_hypotheses_preserved_without_muta.hypothesis: explicit_status raises ContractUnknown immediately, so an early opaque row combined with later malformed, inconsistent or incomplete evidence may classify Unknown before well-formedness is established.
